How It Works

  1. Paste your URL — Enter any long URL into the input field above.
  2. Customize — Choose a random or custom short code, set expiration, and pick a redirect type.
  3. Share — Copy your shortened link or generate a QR code to share it anywhere.
  4. Track — Visit the tracking page to view click analytics for your links.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is brnk.in really free?

Yes, our URL shortening and QR code generation services are 100% free to use. We are supported by minimal advertisements.

Do I need an account to track clicks?

No account is required! Simply go to our Track page and enter your short URL code to view real-time click analytics.

How long do the shortened links last?

By default, links last forever. However, you can use the advanced settings when creating a link to set an automatic expiration date (e.g., 1 hour, 1 day, or 1 week).

Can I customize the short URL?

Yes, you can enter a custom slug in the "Custom Link (optional)" field to create branded links like brnk.in/your-brand.

What is the difference between 301, 302, and 308 redirects?

A 302 redirect (default) is temporary, meaning search engines won't pass SEO authority to the destination. A 301 or 308 redirect is permanent and passes full SEO authority. Advanced users can select their preferred redirect type when shortening a link.
